text: Krokul Armor Sets can be looted from Eredar War Supplies and Legion War Supplies on Argus. They are also a reward from the following missions: *Scour the Surface *Tools of Defiance
Krik'thik is a group of mantid located in Dread Wastes, Townlong Steppes, and Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Krizgut is a goblin in charge of the online store at Blizzard HQ.
__NOTOC__ Kresh the Ripper is a Zandalari dire troll found in Zeb'tula. He is fought by a Horde adventurer and Scout Captain Elsia during the scenario to set up the Dawnseeker Promontory.

Ku'ash is a jungle troll located in Bear's Head in Azshara. He can be seen shooting fireballs at a target pinned on a tree.

__NOTOC__ Krastinovian Disciples are cultists of the Damned in the Weeping Cave in the Western Plaguelands. They are apprentices of Doctor Theolen Krastinov.
Krokul Sledgehammer is a reward from bonus chests of the Class Hall missions.
Krazzworks Gyrocopters are gyrocopters located in the Twilight Highlands.
Krolusk mounts were first added to World of Warcraft with Battle for Azeroth.
__NOTOC__ Krowl Darkmane is a worgen located in the Siege of Boralus.
Krazzlefrazz Officers are orcs located in Drustvar. They ride wolves.
Krazzlefrazz Guards are orcs located in Drustvar. They are armed either with guns or with the axe and shield combination. They are also present during the Faction Assaults.
Krazzlefrazz Peacekeepers are goblins located in Krazzlefrazz Outpost in Drustvar. They are armed with guns, and some appear as death knights. They posted a wanted poster for Sister Lilias.
Krugah is a Zandalari troll mentioned by Sur'jan who wants him dead.
The Krik'thik Band is a quest reward from The Poisoned Mind (quest).
Krato Flipperfoot is a gilgoblin located at the Ashen Strand in Nazjatar.
The Kri'thik are a group of mantid located in Townlong Steppes.

__NOTOC__ Krolusk Hatchlings are juvenile krolusks located in Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun (where they are often seen following Saltspine Krolusks) and in the Temple of Sethraliss.
__NOTOC__ Krolusk Dunecrawlers are krolusks located all over Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Krolusk Dunemites are krolusks following Saltspine Krolusks in the Brine Basin in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Krolusk Sandhunters are krolusks that roam the dune areas north and east of Atul'Aman in Vol'dun. They regularly submerge themselves beneath the sand, only to emerge again to attack prey.
Krolusk Larvae are krolusks located in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Krill Kelpfist is a gilgoblin located in Newhome in Nazjatar.
Krommel is an octopus located in Maedin's Challenge in Nazjatar.
Krik'thik Limbs are found at Gao-Ran Battlefront in Townlong Steppes.

Krugg the Smart is a leader of the Ironbound troggs located atop the Fizzcrank Pumping Station in the Borean Tundra during the Heritage of Gnomeregan questline. He is riding one of the station's Defendo-Tanks.

Kri'vin is a kunchong located where Jin Yang Road meets the Gate of the Setting Sun in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. __NOTOC__
The Kraulguard Poleaxe is a quest reward from Terror of the Kraul.
The Kraulguard Longsword is a quest reward from Terror of the Kraul.
Kruul's Resolve is one of three possible buffs granted from interacting with Ancient Eredun Scrolls in Krokuun.
Krik'thik Battletanks are kunchong located in the Dread Wastes.
Krik'thik Invaders are mantid located in the Gate of the Setting Sun.
Krik'thik Subjugates are mantid located in the Dread Wastes.
Krik'thik Wingguards are mantid located in the Dread Wastes.

Krusher is a gargon located at Wanecrypt Hill in Revendreth.
Kristy Mayospark is a gnome located in Tinker Town in Ironforge.

Kremit is a frog located with Miggy in the Frogmarsh in Nazmir. A lute can be found next to them, which will make a rainbow arch over the two, when interacted with.

Kraxis is a charred behemoth located in the Windswept Aerie of Korthia.

Kroke the Tormented is a rare-elite charred behemoth patrolling the center of the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia. Defeat the "rare" Tormented Demolishers and Kroke may spawn on their death. Kroke's spawn is announced with an emote: : -or- An objective of Conquering Korthia, defeat the behemoth for ~17x Relic Fragment, 4-6x rare-quality anima items (140-210 anima), and 5% progress toward Shaping Fate. The behemoth may also occasionally drop Kroke's Gleaming Spaulders, Kroke's Wingspiked Pauldrons, and Tormented Giant's Legplates.
Kroke's Wingspiked Pauldrons drop from Kroke the Tormented patrolling the center of the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.
Kroke's Gleaming Spaulders drop from Kroke the Tormented patrolling the center of the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.

Kromos is a young wylderdrake companion. It does not appear to be available.

Kulleg Stonehorn is a tauren artisan skinning trainer located in Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Kurinnaxx, a large sand reaver, is the first boss found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. He has a wide aggro radius and can see stealthed rogues. Deep in the marrow of the hive, the Horde led by Varok Saurfang faced Kurinnaxx when they raided the ruins.
Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac drops from Kurinnaxx in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
Kym Wildmane is a tauren druid trainer of the Wildmane clan located on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Kuz is a quilboar with the Razormane tribe found in the Barrens. She was killed years ago, and her skull given to Mangletooth.
Kuray'bin is a jungle troll quest giver located at a guard post outside of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

The Kurenai, Draenei for "redeemed", are a tribe of Broken draenei who have escaped the grasp of their various slavers in Outland and have made their home at Telaar in southern Nagrand. It is there that they seek to rediscover their destiny. They also maintain a small presence at Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh.
Kurmokk is a rare mob gorilla found in Mistvale Valley in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Kul Tiras Marines are humans found sitting isolated atop the crow's nests of two of the beached ships on the outskirts of Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. Before the Cataclysm, there were a number of Kul Tiras Marines found in Tiragarde Keep proper. They were replaced with personnel from the Northwatch Expeditionary Unit following the disaster.
Kul Tiras Sailors can be found in living at Tiragarde Keep with Kul Tiras Marines under the command of Lieutenant Benedict in eastern Durotar. They are often slain by the Horde.

__NOTOC__ Kum'isha the Collector is a Lost One located near the Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands. He believes that greed is the one responsible for the evils in the world and that all races smell of it. The reason he tasks adventurers to gather draenethyst shards and spheres is because he apparently intends to use them to open a portal to his homeland. His spot is now a place of Okrilla and her group of warriors. During the Draenei heritage armor quest he is one of the two Lost One who can be seen speaking with other characters like Iorioa or Hamanar throughout the tishamaat celebration in the Exodar, being the other Elder Kuruti. Kurdros is an Alliance gryphon found in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Kurdros and Granistad guard the passage to the Hinterlands.
The Kurenai Tabard is a mark of honor amongst the Kurenai faction and is only available to the Kurenai's must trusted allies.
Kurzen War Panthers are panthers found in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurzen War Tigers are tigers found in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurz the Revelator is a furbolg located at Stillpine Hold in Azuremyst Isle.
Kudrii is a draenei located at the Crystal Hall in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Kum'isha's Junk is a quest reward from One Draenei's Junk....
Kurenai Captive is a Broken quest giver located at Sunspring Post in Nagrand.

Kyle the Frenzied is a timber wolf that belongs to Ahab Wheathoof. Ahab wants your help in getting Kyle's favorite food, Tender Strider Meat, and then giving it to Kyle so he will come home. Kyle runs around Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Kurzen's Mystery is an Alliance-only quest in which players are asked to visit troll ruins in Stranglethorn Vale and transcribe legends from tablets they find there. Brother Nimetz believes these tablets may tell the reasons behind Colonel Kurzen's corruption.
__NOTOC__ Kurzen Headshrinkers are humans found at Kurzen's Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurzen Jungle Fighter can be found in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
Kurgatok is an orc that can be found in Stonebreaker Hold, Terokkar Forest.

Kurzen Medicine Man can be found in Northern Stranglethorn. To prevent insubordination, Kurzen had his Medicine Men distribute an elixir throughout the compound under the guise of medicine. The elixir contains the blood of Crystal Spine Basilisks and a strange Whispering Blue Stone.
Kurzen Witch Doctors are humans found in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurzill is a tothrezim barbarian and primal. He is a member of a group of tothrezim debt collectors led by Thathrell, maintained for particularly dangerous debt collections.
Kurzen Commandos are humans found in Northern Stranglethorn. They walk around in stealth.

The kvaldir (sometimes capitalized, and pronounced KUH-vall-deer), also known as sea vrykul, are the spirits of fearsome vrykul warriors or seafaring raiders who roam the seas raiding ships and coastal settlements. Working for Helya, the kvaldir raid the coasts and pull souls to Helheim, thus robbing Odyn of potential champions. The spirits of those dishonorable warriors spend eternity in Helheim locked in an endless futile battle, always seeking glory but never able to attain it. The tuskarr call the kvaldir tuk-hariq, meaning "walkers of the fog" in their language. They also refer to the kvaldir as sons of the mist.
Kuk'uq is a tuskarr spearcrafter dwelling in Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.
Kul Tiras Wine is found in the Wine Crate on the seafloor northeast of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Kvaldir Raiders are kvaldir found at Kaskala in the Borean Tundra, disembarking from longships and attacking the area.
Kul Inkspiller is an Inscription supplies vendor in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

Kyle the Friendly is a dog that belongs to Ahab Wheathoof. Ahab wants your help in getting Kyle's favorite food, Tender Strider Meat, and then giving it to Kyle so he will come home. Kyle runs around Bloodhoof Village in the tauren territory of Mulgore.
Kurun is an elite stone giant quest giver located atop the hill over Thor Modan in Grizzly Hills. A faction of earthen is associated with him.
Kurzel tears a strip off her blouse for you for the quest * Head Games It is up to you to dip it in the blood of Novos the Summoner and return it to Mack Fearsen.

The Kul Tiras Elite Corps was a detachment of troops within the Human Expedition that were led by Jaina Proudmoore to Kalimdor. They were made up of Tirasian people. A base of the Corps was wiped out by the Horde. Later, their gryphon riders guarded the Human Expedition forces stationed at the entrance to the Stonetalon Peak.
The Kvaldir War Horn is provided by High Crusader Adelard for the -level daily quest Drottinn Hrothgar (quest).

Kul the Reckless can be found inside the Black Cage nearest the freshly-resurrected Black Knight on the ledge of Deathspeaker's Watch in Icecrown. Kul, upon learning of the Cult of the Damned setting up camp, hastily took a group of unprepared aspirants up to the watch and was summarily captured. Players are tasked to free him and several unlucky Captive Aspirants on the daily quest You've Really Done It This Time, Kul before they become Sacrificed Aspirants.

Kvaldir Deepcallers can be found on the kvaldir raiding vessel in the middle of Sea Reaver's Run. They are summoning the North Sea Kraken from the depths of the North Sea to attack The Wavecrest and The Firehawk, respectively sent by the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers, which had to slay the kraken they kept summoning, with the help of adventurers. However, the deepcallers were so absorbed in their summoning ritual that they were not aware of crusaders landing on their ship and preparing to attack them. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the Kvaldir Deepcallers are still bringing up krakens to attack any ship that tries to pass through the strait.
__NOTOC__ Kvaldir Berserkers are boarding The Wavecrest and The Firehawk in the middle of Sea Reaver's Run, south of Hrothgar's Landing.
__NOTOC__ Kvaldir Harpooners are vrykul boarding The Wavecrest and The Firehawk in the middle of Sea Reaver's Run, south of Hrothgar's Landing.
Kul'de is a Grand Master leatherworking trainer who can be found at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. During Death Rising, he was defending the area.
Kvaldir Crewmen are kvaldir that paddles the boat with Orabus the Helmsman on board to Warsong Jetty in the Borean Tundra when Horn of the Ancient Mariner is blown. They attack one at a time.
Kvaldir Mistweavers are kvaldir that create and spread mist for their brethren to inhabit at Garrosh's Landing in the Borean Tundra.
Kvaldir Mist Lords are kvaldir found at Garrosh's Landing in the Borean Tundra.
Kurisu's Indecision is contained in Eadric's Cache after defeating Eadric the Pure at the Trial of the Champion in heroic mode.
Kvaldir Attack Plans drop from Kvaldir in Hrothgar's Landing.
Kvaldir Battle Standard is a quest reward from Visions of the Past: The Slaughter of Biel'aran Ridge.
Kvaldir Reavers are creatures that, along with Kvaldir Mist Binders, can be killed for the quests Stop The Aggressors (Alliance)/Stop The Aggressors (Horde).
Kuruk's Goods is a shop found on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff.
Kurtok the Slayer is the leader of the Blackrock Clan invasion on Northshire Valley.
Kvaldir High-Shaman are kvaldir located at Biel'aran Ridge in Shimmering Expanse.
The Kurzen Compound Prison Records are found in Kurzen Compound Prison Records within the Kurzen Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.
__NOTOC__ Kurzen Compound Officers' Dossier is found within the Kurzen Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurzen's Expedition was an expedition of humans from Stormwind led by Colonel Conrad Kurzen.

Kul Tiras Treasure can be found in the ruined buildings of Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. Gail Nozzywig refers to it as "abandoned Kul Tiras knickknacks" and says it's worthless in Kalimdor, implying that it's valuable elsewhere.
Kul Tiras Leggings are a quest reward from From Bad to Worse.
Kurzen Wranglers can be found at Kurzen's Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kurzen Shadow Hunters can be found at Kurzen's Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.

Kvaldir Dreadbringers are kvaldir located in the Shimmering Expanse.
Kun-Pai Ritual Charms can be found in the Wood of Staves, hanging from trees.

Kuo-Na Quillpaw is a pandaren located at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in Krasarang Wilds. She and her brother are members of the Crane Wing order and asks adventurers to prove their dexterity by capturing the Spirits of the Crane. Thelonius sends trainees to duel her.

The Kun-Lai Summit storyline takes place after the Valley of the Four Winds and Krasarang Wilds storylines. s show up at Stoneplow, Halfhill, and the Grassy Cline offering a message from in the form of the breadcrumb The Road to Kun-Lai. The summit can be accessed via the Veiled Stair, which begins at the Grassy Cline in the northeast part of Valley of the Four Winds. The Spring Drifter offers a free boat ride through the level 90-infested Ancient Passage, dropping adventurers off at Binan Village in the southeast corner of the summit zone. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Slum It in the Summit. Near the end of the Shado-Pan Monastery quest chain, adventurers have

__NOTOC__ Kun-Lai Corpsepickers are vultures located in Shado-Li Basin in Kun-Lai Summit.

Kyo was the tiger pet of Che Wildwalker found at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He died when the Sha of Pride emerged. The Spirit of Kyo may sometimes be summoned from Elixir of Wandering Spirits.
__NOTOC__ Kypari Crawlers are Kyparite worms located in the Briny Muck in Dread Wastes.

, a fully-grown kypari tree]] , a sha-corrupted kypari tree]] The kypari amber trees are massive trees native to the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes. The kypari trees are sacred to the mantid and are regarded as living shrines steeped in their culture. They are the foundation of mantid society. Each tree carries with it a name bestowed upon it by the mantid. The mantid who live at that tree, be it in the roots, in the branches, in the nooks and crannies, share a name with that tree.

Kypari Vor is a kypari tree in northeastern Dread Wastes that has been corrupted by the sha energies along the Horrid March. Vor is southeast of the kypari tree containing the Amber Vault and the Sunset Brewgarden, northeast of the Thundering Run and Klaxxi'vess, and southwest of the kypari tree comprising the Gao-Ran Battlefront in Townlong Steppes. The Horror Clutch is in the kypari's western shadow along the march. Kypari Vor was once beautiful, rich with amber and surrounded by prime hunting grounds.

Kypari Ik was a kypari tree in central Dread Wastes that has been corrupted by the sha energies running along the southern fork of the Horrid March. Panic Clutch is in what's left of Ik's northeastern shadow, Kypari Zar is southeast, the Duskroot Fen is to the south, and the Stinging Trail is to the southwest.

Kunzen Cave can be found just north of Kunzen Village on the Skyrange of Valley of the Four Winds. The cave looks out over the Springtail Crag on the ridge to the east, and the mouth of the Cavern of Endless Echoes and Cattail Lake far below. It's from here that the Kunzen Chief Yip-Yip leads the tribe.

Kunzen Rockflingers are hozen of the Kunzen tribe at Kunzen Village of Valley of the Four Winds. They are in groups of three-five.

Kubb is a rare kobold located south of Algaz Station, by the cave where "Commander" Nazrim dwells. He is part of the Axis of Awful.

Kypari Sap Container is a common mantid archaeology artifact, created from 50 Mantid Archaeology Fragment. One Mantid Amber Sliver may be used to solve this artifact. A pristine version can also be crafted.

Kuai the Brute is the leader of the Gurthan clan. He and his clan have gathered at the Mogu'shan Palace, alongside clans Harthak and Kargesh to prove their worth to their king.
Kun-Lai Kicker is sold in stacks of 5 for by: *Brewmaster Boof on Timeless Isle * in Durotar (Brewfest) * in Dun Morogh (Brewfest)
Kylo Kelwin is a goblin PvP rewards vendor located at Underbelly in Dalaran. He sells older seasons' gear in exchange for Marks of Honor.
Kun-Da is a mogu in the Spoils of Pandaria encounter in Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kur'ak the Binder is a orc found in Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge. Occasionally, he goes to hammer on a Blacksmith's Anvil.

__NOTOC__ Kuros can be found on top of the Altar of Bones in the Gladiator's Sanctum in Lunarfall.

The proud and belligerent dwarf Kurdran is one of the more notorious heroes of the Second War. Having slain nine Dragons throughout the course of the war, Kurdran and his Gryphon Sky'rie retain the reputation as being undisputed masters of the skies. Kurdran works for the Alliance forces in Azeroth as a scout and warrior to this day.

Kuo is a pandaren angler, brother to Mei Pa, and cousin to Shi Ga. One stormy night when the three were fishing they rescued a drowning Alliance soldier named Tarlo Mondan. After rescuing Tarlo, they continued, and invited him to joining them in, fishing. As they fished they told Tarlo the tale of Xun, and remarked afterwords that they seek to continue Xun's work by not only feeding others but to forge their own legacies and stories.
Kwahu Fiendtamer is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Kuma Thunderhide is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Kugra the Frostforger is an orc located at the Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge.
The Kvaldir Seaweed Disguise was a quest reward from Stealth by Seaweed.

Kuuro's Claim is a mine in Talador under the control of the draenei. Crew Chief Dearii is apparently in charge. Recently there was goren attack that infested the mine and killed over half of the miners before they could evacuate.
The Kvaldir Raiding Horn was never made available, and its entry in the Toy Box was later removed to reflect this.
Kur'talos Ravencrest's Spectral Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Kyle Harrison is a game designer for Blizzard Entertainment.
